character.name: Zero
character.portraitAlt: Zero after a year of chamber training: muscular human with auburn curls, beard, green iris and red scouter, in a black outfit and burgundy cape. Capsule Corp illustration backdrop.
character.origin: From a world where Dragon Ball is fiction. The cause of the crossing is still unknown.
character.appearance: Approximately 5′8″ (173 cm), up from the original 5′6″ through gradual Dark Factor adaptation visible after the chamber. Muscular post-chamber build, long curly auburn hair, full auburn beard and normally green irises. Pale violet aura and red irises while Dark Factor Sealed Channel is active; no other transformation changes. Black-and-burgundy outfit with matching cape, boots and recovered red scouter. The original outfit and scouter were repaired after the second Nappa encounter. A permanent black circle with four inward-curving hooks marks the upper abdomen below the sternum. The portrait remains a standard-outfit reference, not a literal snapshot of every scene.
character.personality: Expressed through your choices and dialogue.
character.backstory: Familiar with Dragon Ball through anime, manga, films and games before the crossing. No further personal background is recorded.
character.arrival: Woke outside Capsule Corp in West City with an unfamiliar athletic body and new clothes. Nappa’s attack left him critically injured. Vegeta intervened, arranged evacuation and later proved to be a Time Patroller. Zero gave his name before losing consciousness. Zero later chose 1 January, the Conton-calendar arrival anniversary, as his birthday. His adopted age anchor is 26 years and 6 months at arrival; personal ageing includes chamber time.
character.motivation: Build independent strength, study on Namek and Yardrat, and gather a compatible Dragon Ball set to stabilise the Dark Factor into usable bodily power.
character.knowledge: Retains Dragon Ball media knowledge without knowing every alternate history. Chronoa confirmed the Xenoverse stories correspond to the Patrol’s past. Zero knows the Dark Factor can take bodily control and that Kaioken destabilises its opened seal; its identity and the cause of his crossing remain unknown. He and Yamcha revived Krillin, Roshi, Tien and Chiaotzu in TL-503, then returned for a full conditional-history review. That course includes Namek/Yardrat training and a destructive Android crisis in Ages 767–768. Six weeks under a resident King Kai developed Kaioken, sensing and a small Spirit Bomb exercise. Zero defeated fruit-enhanced Nappa on Namek in TL-619, was rescued from Turles by Vegeta and Yamcha, and heard the completed mission review. He has disclosed his integration-wish intention to Chronoa, who offered help with wording. Guru released Zero’s own potential with the seal closed; the first scan was 69,497. Yamcha and the three visiting native fighters also received releases. Four weeks of training with Nail brought Zero to 77,000 before returning to Conton. Zero and Yamcha captured Brask and Rivet on TL-846 and secured their weapons and shuttle. The ship used a booked external passage; its operator remains unidentified. Continued training with Vegeta, King Kai and Yamcha brought Zero to 79,807. Hercule has now confirmed TL-503 integrity at 100% and its native Yardrat expedition; the travellers’ own stay and departure are not yet booked.
character.limitations: Supervised trainee; visits need dispatch approval. Kaioken ×2 has reached 60 seconds in controlled moving practice. Full sealed channel has reached three strenuous moving minutes; neither is a fixed timer or mastery. Combining them triggered a takeover and is not viable now. Ki sensing estimates relative current output, not exact numbers or hidden reserves. Spirit Spear now repeats a modest contact charge during moving practice but remains developing; no stable ki blade, absorption or Yardrat instruction.
character.powerReading: Measured · 28 June, Age 854 · After morning training · Form totals calculated
character.condition: All forms and Kaioken inactive; seal closed and intact. Tired and mildly sore after morning training, no serious injury. Main outfit, cape and scouter worn; communicator under collar. Travel bag and protected scroll in Room 214; two Dragon Balls stored there. No Senzu carried.

abilities.title: Combat fundamentals
abilities.summary: Footwork, guards, counters and combinations on the ground and in the air.
abilities.effect: Compact movement and close-range defence; training includes weighted and gravity-loaded rounds.
abilities.control: Ground rounds at 75× gravity, aerial rounds at 25× and slow conditioning at 150× are distinct demonstrations. Vegeta still controls their exchanges.
abilities.development: Close-range defence and recovery after interrupted attacks are the current focus.
abilities.artworkAlt: Footwork, guards, counters and combinations on the ground and in the air. Symbolic technique illustration.

trainingRecord.text: Chamber benchmarks remain 75× gravity for ground rounds, 25× for aerial rounds and 150× for slow conditioning; no higher maximum has been established. Peer sparring and cleanup work developed group awareness. In TL-619, tight counters, accumulated damage and sustained pressure let Zero defeat a stronger Nappa while using the sealed channel. Vegeta remained far beyond him; their following training day focused on recovering after interrupted attacks, using separate channel bouts, closure and rest. Four weeks with Nail and the quarry fight developed aerial reversals, guarded combinations and sustained pressure against injured Brask. Subsequent Vegeta rounds improved close-range defence; he still controls their exchanges.

abilities.title: Ki control
abilities.summary: Directs ki through movement, flight and energy release.
abilities.effect: Deliberate regulation of personal output supports loaded movement and transitions between techniques.
abilities.control: Lower-flow channeling is steadier; full channel output remains strenuous. Control practice does not permanently absorb channel or donated spirit energy.
abilities.development: Recent King Kai and Nail instruction improved transitions and recovery.
abilities.artworkAlt: Directs ki through movement, flight and energy release. Symbolic technique illustration.

trainingRecord.text: Deliberate suppression, loaded movement, flight and moving releases are established. King Kai’s instruction improves whole-body transitions and control under strain. Lower-flow channeling is steadier; full output remains strenuous. Ki sensing is now trained separately, with limited relative-output tracking. Neither the channel nor cooperative spirit-energy gathering has permanently absorbed another power into the base. Nail’s month of instruction and the latest King Kai sessions improved movement, transitions and recovery; no new gravity or endurance maximum was established.

abilities.title: Flight
abilities.summary: Uses ki to stay airborne, manoeuvre and fight.
abilities.effect: Sustained aerial movement includes turns, bracing, controlled rotations and flight-assisted attacks.
abilities.control: Aerial rounds reached 25× gravity. Long-range endurance remains unmeasured; gravity practice does not erase an opponent’s power advantage.
abilities.development: Flight is integrated into live combat and evasive combinations.
abilities.artworkAlt: Uses ki to stay airborne, manoeuvre and fight. Symbolic technique illustration.

trainingRecord.text: Flight is integrated with evasions, compact strikes and spinning kicks against drones. Full-output aerial rounds reached 25× gravity, distinct from 75× ground rounds and 150× slow conditioning. Flight has now been used in the assessment and both Nappa encounters. Long-range endurance remains unmeasured; greater training gravity did not make Zero faster than a much stronger opponent. Flight-assisted reversals and aerial pressure were also used against Brask.

abilities.title: Ki blasts
abilities.summary: Fires ki projectiles, volleys and charged shots.
abilities.effect: Ordinary ki attacks can be released while moving or charged for a larger shot. Limited preset curves have been demonstrated.
abilities.control: Accuracy and stamina remain finite. Larger shots need an opening. Curved fire is not homing; no stable blade or named beam has been learned.
abilities.development: Practising cleaner gathering and tighter moving volleys.
abilities.appearance: Yellow-white energy shots; the first shot chipped a practice wall.
abilities.artworkAlt: Fires ki projectiles, volleys and charged shots. Symbolic technique illustration.

trainingRecord.text: Started with one small shot on Day 22. Chamber practice developed step-release, moving-target fire and short volleys while manoeuvring. Larger shots require an opening and consume more stamina; accuracy remains imperfect. These are ordinary ki attacks, not an acquired named beam or signature technique. In the mission he destroyed the warehouse with an outward release and used contact blasts and concentrated ki at his fingertips. No stable blade was acquired in that fight. During Yamcha’s Raditz fight, a precise shot destroyed the scouter with only superficial burns to Raditz, leaving Yamcha to win his own fight. On Namek, twenty ordinary shots followed preset wide curves; three hit Nappa from behind. This was limited curved fire, not homing or Yamcha’s Spirit Ball. Spirit Spear is recorded separately.

abilities.title: Power suppression
abilities.summary: Lowers emitted power and deliberately releases it for action.
abilities.effect: Usually holds near half output during ordinary waking activity and familiar drills.
abilities.control: Hard surprises can cause spikes. Sleep maintenance, perfect concealment and instant expert switching are unestablished. Suppression increases effort under a load; it does not multiply training gains.
abilities.development: Deliberate full-power striking bursts followed by renewed suppression have been used in the field.
abilities.artworkAlt: Lowers emitted power and deliberately releases it for action. Symbolic technique illustration.

trainingRecord.text: Self-taught in the chamber and checked with the scouter. The final test stayed near 1,538 through walking and a short combination, then returned deliberately to 3,075. Hard surprises can still cause spikes. Sleep and unconscious maintenance, perfect concealment and instant expert switching are not established. Suppression makes a given load harder; it does not multiply training gains. The opening soldier engagement demonstrated a deliberate full-power striking burst followed by a return to half output. At the current recorded base, half output would be about 39,904; that calculation is not a new suppression check. Difficulty sensing a deeply suppressed opponent does not undo Zero’s own suppression skill.

abilities.title: Uncontrolled Dark Factor
abilities.summary: Releases the Dark Factor through an involuntary, dangerous manifestation.
abilities.artworkAlt: Symbolic black-and-violet horned energy eruption for Uncontrolled Dark Factor.
abilities.effect: The attachment can take control of Zero’s body; this is a witnessed manifestation, not a safe voluntary transformation.
abilities.control: Chronoa’s seal contains it. Losing consciousness or nearing death with the channel open can trigger takeover. The failed Kaioken/channel test also triggered it while conscious: Kaioken collapsed and ×15 replaced ×10, without stacking.
abilities.development: Containment remains intact; voluntary mastery has not been achieved.
abilities.appearance: A dense black-and-violet mantle encloses body, hair and clothes, slightly enlarging the silhouette, with horn-like projections and pale claws. Reversion exposes the underlying clothes and injuries without repairing damage. The layered growling laugh is not a separate technique.

trainingRecord.text: Power erupted after a voice that felt like Zero’s own thoughts offered strength. Fighting Nappa felt dreamlike and apparently voluntary until the body turned toward a city against his wishes. Vegeta stopped him before he reached it. The dense mantle encloses his body, hair and clothes and slightly enlarges his silhouette; reversion reveals what was underneath without repairing battle damage. Its layered growling laugh is not a new technique. This is a recorded manifestation, not a safe transformation he can freely activate. A brief second takeover occurred during the 15 April Kaioken/channel test; Krillin stopped it immediately. Kaioken dropped out, so ×15 replaced the channel without stacking. Chronoa checked and settled the intact seal.

abilities.title: Dark Factor Sealed Channel
abilities.summary: Draws Dark Factor power through Chronoa’s seal while retaining control.
abilities.artworkAlt: A circular four-hook seal containing pale violet energy, symbolising Dark Factor Sealed Channel.
abilities.effect: Voluntary opening, regulation and closure of the flow developed through supervised practice.
abilities.control: Three strenuous minutes at full output in moving drills are demonstrated, not a fixed timer or mastery. Repeated attempts remain tiring. Kaioken stacking is unsafe. Loss of consciousness or near-death while channeling can trigger the uncontrolled state; closed-channel sleep is safe. Safe removal remains unresolved.
abilities.development: Recent practice improved recovery without a new timed maximum; no permanent absorption of the multiplier.
abilities.appearance: Pale violet aura and red irises, with ordinary physique and hair colour. The permanent seal is a black circle with four inward-curving hooks below the sternum. The icon is symbolic; the Character gallery carries the full appearance.

trainingRecord.text: Voluntary opening and closure developed through supervised practice. Full output reached three moving minutes during the first cleanup week; by 10 March the sequence ended without immediate leg trembling, but still left Zero winded and repeated attempts were tiring. No permanent absorption of the multiplier is established. If he loses consciousness or approaches death while channeling, Uncontrolled Dark Factor takes over: ×15 replaces ×10, rather than stacking. Ordinary sleep with the channel closed is safe. The seal contains the attachment; safe removal remains unresolved. The ability icon is symbolic; the character gallery retains the full appearance reference. Attempting Kaioken on top of the channel caused loss of control even while conscious. The seal itself remained intact after Chronoa’s check; separate channel use resumed. On Namek, Zero defeated Nappa while retaining control, then closed the flow before losing consciousness after Turles’s ambush. Later practice with Vegeta improved recovery without a new timed maximum.

abilities.title: Kaioken
abilities.summary: Amplifies Zero’s own output for short periods.
abilities.artworkAlt: A crimson Kaioken aura around a symbolic fighter silhouette.
abilities.effect: King Kai’s technique raises personal output. Every learned stage remains available when a higher stage is unlocked.
abilities.control: ×2 is the only unlocked stage. A 60-second moving demonstration is recorded, not a universal limit. Guru’s release grants no automatic endurance increase. Use separately from the sealed channel; their failed combination is not an available ×20 form.
abilities.development: Latest practice improved activation and release while moving.
abilities.appearance: A crimson aura surrounds the fighter during activation.

trainingRecord.text: First achieved on 24 March, then developed through six weeks of instruction. Activation, release and movement are possible; no ×3 or higher factor is established. Stacking onto the opened seal triggered Uncontrolled Dark Factor on 15 April. That failed combination is not an available ×20 form. Four further weeks of instruction extended the moving demonstration to one minute. Guru’s release does not itself establish longer endurance. A short ×2 burst injured Brask before his transformation. The latest week improved activation and release while moving; ×2 remains the demonstrated ceiling.

abilities.title: Ki sensing
abilities.summary: Locates familiar ki and estimates relative current output.
abilities.effect: Direction and short-range tracking can be followed during movement, including familiar partially suppressed signatures.
abilities.control: Exact numbers, hidden reserves and deeply suppressed targets cannot be read reliably. Familiarity and concentration matter; the scouter still supplies numerical readings.
abilities.development: Close-range tracking helped counter Brask’s flash; moving tracking continues to improve.
abilities.artworkAlt: Locates familiar ki and estimates relative current output. Symbolic technique illustration.

trainingRecord.text: King Kai’s exercises developed direction and short-range tracking during movement. Zero cannot read exact numbers, hidden reserves or deeply suppressed targets reliably. Familiarity and concentration matter; the scouter still supplies numerical readings. Later practice improved tracking familiar moving signatures without stopping to concentrate. Against Brask, close-range ki tracking helped counter a flash. Recent practice follows familiar and partially suppressed moving signatures; exact values still require the scouter.

abilities.title: Spirit Bomb
abilities.summary: Gathers voluntarily offered spirit energy into a charge.
abilities.effect: A small cooperative charge has been gathered and released in training.
abilities.control: Gathering takes time and concentration. A large battlefield-ready Spirit Bomb, unlimited environmental draw and permanent absorption are not established.
abilities.development: Early supervised practice under King Kai.
abilities.appearance: Blue-white spirit energy gathers into a distinct sphere above raised hands. The icon represents the technique, not an established maximum size.
abilities.artworkAlt: Symbolic fighter gathering a blue-white sphere above raised hands.

trainingRecord.text: Voluntarily offered energy supported the first small successful exercise. Gathering takes concentration and time. No large battlefield-ready Spirit Bomb, unlimited environmental draw or permanent absorption is established.

abilities.title: Spirit Spear
abilities.summary: Releases gathered spirit energy through a palm strike on contact.
abilities.artworkAlt: Spirit energy gathering into an open hand and spreading across the front of its palm and fingers.
abilities.effect: A gathered charge is concentrated through the hand and spent when released into the target.
abilities.control: A modest contact charge repeats in moving practice. No sustained beam, fixed multiplier, permanent gain, hostile energy theft or full mastery is established.
abilities.development: Practising a repeatable approach and contact release with a modest charge.
abilities.appearance: Blue-white spirit energy gathers into the hand and spreads over the front of the palm and fingers before release on contact. The skin remains visible beneath the gathered energy; the whole hand does not glow. No separate floating ball or literal spear.

trainingRecord.text: Zero named and first attempted it against Nappa on Namek. The first discharge scorched armour; the second tighter pulse breached a small section of already-damaged back armour and burned beneath it. It did not pierce through Nappa or become a sustained beam. The gathered charge is spent on release. No assigned multiplier, permanent power gain, hostile energy theft or full mastery. During the latest week, a modest gathered charge became repeatable on a moving training approach and contact. A sustained beam, fixed multiplier and large reliable combat charge remain unestablished.

inventory.details: Turles’s ambush broke the scouter; equipment services repaired and returned the same device on 22 April. Two post-fight readings were 5,190; the next evening’s readings were 5,213. Temporal transit persistently scrambles standard scouter networking, not local scans. Return travel, rebooting and this repair do not reconnect it or upload stored recordings. Untouched local scouters still work: Jeice and Burter’s report reached Frieza. The Patrol communicator is separate.

inventory.title: Time Patrol communicator pin

inventory.details: The TP emblem pin is the communicator, not a separate decorative badge. Concealed beneath the collar and functional. Used for integrity reports, extraction requests and local messages. Purpose-built Patrol communications remain usable across temporal travel; the original scouter’s disconnected network is separate. Patrol apparel is provided and wearing its insignia is viewed favourably, but it is optional; many Patrollers conceal their communicator inside their own clothing.

inventory.title: Conton City Dragon Balls
inventory.summary: Two compatible reward balls collected toward one complete set.
inventory.details: Four-Star Ball: received on 23 April for Zero’s first commendation; wrapped in clean cloth. Two-Star Ball: received on 22 May for four weeks of cleanup service; kept in its padded case. Both are in the bottom drawer of the bedside cabinet in Room 214. The other five are not reserved. No wish has been made. This is a standard Time Patrol reserve set, separate from the TL-503 Earth Dragon Balls. More powerful variants are reserved for senior Patrollers and exceptional Patrol matters.

inventory.details: Spare clothes, toiletries and ordinary travel essentials. Retrieved from dispatch after the quarry mission and stored in Room 214 with Chronoa’s protected scroll. No unrecorded special equipment or Senzu.

inventory.details: Guru read it before examining Zero. Zero accepted the returned scroll before training with Nail and brought it home in its protective case. It remains inside the travel bag, not a removal spell.

accounts.title: Patrol support
accounts.summary: Assigned accommodation and dining-hall meals are covered.
accounts.details: Housing, meals and necessary treatment remain Patrol provision. Zero has consumed 36 Senzu: 28 before the chamber, six inside it, one in the ward and one carried by Yamcha during the Namek rescue. None remain in Zero’s inventory. Field repair covered the broken scouter; the outfit was also repaired. Borrowed training equipment remains facility property. The commendation was redeemed for the Four-Star Dragon Ball; it is not an outstanding credit or a complete wish. A second commendation for eight further cleanup assignments was redeemed for the Two-Star Ball; Zero has no unspent commendation. Yamcha’s separate new commendation is unspent.

sections.text: White-and-gold Saiyan armour over blue combat clothes; retained tail. Proud, impatient and contemptuous, with early-Z temperament.

sections.title: Relationship & current circumstances
sections.text: His independent training and missions continued while Zero was on Namek. He now conducts longer technical rounds against Zero’s Sealed Channel while remaining in base, but still easily controls the fight. His dedicated gravity room has persistent settings and guest controls with maintenance access. Current output is an authorised reader assessment, not a new reading or disclosure by Vegeta.

people.title: Krillin
people.summary: Combat instructor for Mr. Satan’s roster; Zero’s first combat and ki teacher.

sections.title: Identity & appearance
sections.text: Compact muscular build, bald with six forehead dots, orange gi and blue wristbands; lively, informal and wry.

sections.title: Relationship & current circumstances
sections.text: He introduced Zero and Yamcha to a resident King Kai on 11 March. He does not teach or claim to know Kaioken himself. On 15 April he immediately contained the failed Kaioken/channel takeover; Chronoa checked the seal. His earlier offer of Tri-Form remains unlearned. He lives with Eighteen and Marron; their informal visit is still unscheduled. This instructor is distinct from the Krillin revived in TL-503. On 28 June he passed Yamcha’s Alpha-training inquiry to instructor contacts; no teacher or appointment is confirmed.

sections.title: Identity & appearance
sections.text: Boisterous showman with a thick moustache, curly hair, burgundy outfit, white cape, championship belt and dispatch headset.

facts.label: Service
facts.value: Joined with family four Conton years ago

sections.title: Relationship & current circumstances
sections.text: He briefed and oversaw the TL-218 supply investigation and issued Zero’s communicator. Family background: Pan is his actual granddaughter; he joined Conton with Pan, Gohan and Videl on 16 February Age 850. His authority comes from dispatch, not high combat power. This family history and exact age are reference information, not a conversation Zero has had. Coordinated the TL-503 homecoming and later TL-619 extraction and reviews. He presented the commendations and confirmed Yamcha’s apartment and Vegeta’s training-room handovers. On 22 May he confirmed full restoration to 100% and approved a Namek-only visit of up to four weeks, with a two-week check-in. Earth requires separate review. The Namek visit is now complete; he has confirmed TL-503’s recovery and is arranging the proposed Yardrat itinerary.

people.title: Chronoa
people.summary: Supreme Kai of Time and leader of the Time Patrol.

sections.title: Identity & appearance
sections.text: Small, pink-skinned, pointed ears, swept orange hair, gold earrings and purple-and-gold clothing. Brisk, curious and authoritative.

sections.title: Relationship & current circumstances
sections.text: Her post-outbreak examination identified Dark Factor that was undetected while dormant. She sealed it while Zero was awake, leaving the four-hook abdominal mark, and explained the danger of losing consciousness or nearing death with the channel open. She is investigating whether safe removal is possible; no answer or deadline is established. After the 15 April stacking failure, she checked the intact binding and settled it closed. At the commendation meeting she heard Zero’s integration-wish intention, considered bodily integration viable and offered help with wording. No wish or removal has occurred. Before the Namek departure she supplied a briefing for Guru and explained that Zero’s own potential can be released with the channel closed.

sections.title: Relationship & current circumstances

sections.title: Relationship & current circumstances
