events.title: Awakening in West City
events.summary: Zero wakes on his back, notices an athletic body and unfamiliar clothes, then stands outside Capsule Corp.
events.details: Nappa approaches from the damaged street and swings a backhand toward him.

events.title: A punch that changes nothing
events.summary: Zero ducks the casual swing and puts his weight behind a punch to Nappa’s jaw. It lands without harming him.
events.details: Nappa grabs his upper arm, knees his abdomen and throws him onto the paving. Zero remains conscious, hurt and struggling to breathe.

events.title: Anger against a Saiyan
events.summary: Surrounded by destruction and dead civilians, Zero insults Nappa and charges again.
events.details: Nappa strikes his face and ribs, drops him and moves to stomp him. A recognisable Vegeta interrupts and orders Nappa away. Anger did not close the power gap.

events.title: Vegeta intervenes
events.summary: Zero lunges at distracted Nappa with clawing and biting attempts; Nappa restrains him without visible injury.
events.details: Vegeta knocks Nappa unconscious with two strikes. Nappa is still breathing. Vegeta scans Zero with an unfamiliar instrument and asks what he is.

events.title: A name and a scouter
events.summary: Critically injured and vomiting blood, Zero takes Nappa’s scouter and whispers his name.
events.details: Vegeta speaks to an unseen contact about the readings, then calls for medical recovery. Zero is placed in an emergency transport cradle. The reply from the other end is inaudible.

events.title: Waking in Conton City
events.summary: Zero wakes in a Time Patrol medical ward, physically healed, and meets Dr. Rill.
events.details: She reports treatment and clear scans, including the repaired head injury. His clothes and scouter were kept. About an hour has passed since admission; no permanent physical deficit remains.

events.title: The Time Patrol
events.summary: Zero asks where he is and why. Rill explains the emergency extraction and identifies Vegeta as a Patroller.
events.details: She describes the Patrol’s work against interference with history and asks for his last memory before West City.

events.title: Fiction somewhere else
events.summary: Zero describes going to sleep and waking changed in West City, and says this world is fiction where he comes from.
events.details: Rill records his account as unverified and forwards it to coordination. Zero insists he must be dreaming.

events.title: The first reading · 50
events.summary: Zero confirms his clothing and body changed, activates the recovered scouter and experiments with its controls.
events.details: Rill assists by scanning him twice: 50. She returns the device. Recovery itself granted no power increase.

events.title: Cleared to leave the ward
events.summary: Zero asks whether he is free to go. Rill distinguishes medical discharge from the pending assessment.
events.details: An authorised escort is required beyond the ward. The automated reply confirms Mr. Satan has been notified.

events.title: The illustrious dispatcher
events.summary: Zero dresses in his original outfit. Mr. Satan arrives and introduces his “Temporal Super Stars.”
events.details: Assessment is in reception room three, across the square. Satan confirms clearance and offers to escort Zero.

events.title: An audience with Chronoa
events.summary: Zero follows Mr. Satan to the assessment room, where Chronoa and his rescuer Vegeta wait.
events.details: Chronoa has read Rill’s report. She asks what the game showed him about this place.

events.title: Knowledge of their past
events.summary: Zero recounts the first two Xenoverse main stories. Chronoa confirms that the account matches real past events.
events.details: The two stories had distinct hero Patrollers; the second happened about two hub years ago. She asks whether Zero can identify this particular Vegeta’s history.

events.title: The offer
events.summary: Zero summarises his broader Dragon Ball knowledge but acknowledges he cannot identify an unfamiliar alternate Vegeta.
events.details: Chronoa confirms the control question and offers supervised trainee membership, housing and instruction. Vegeta says his correction mission is complete, without explaining it, and fiercely objects to the proposed partnership.

events.title: A reluctant partner
events.summary: Zero accepts and honestly questions whether he would slow Vegeta down.
events.details: Chronoa records the acceptance and explains the supervision. Satan handles logistics. Vegeta’s ordinary field deployment is initially suspended until Zero is ready, provoking open resentment.

events.title: Meeting the instructor
events.summary: Zero follows Satan to the training hall; Vegeta accompanies them. Krillin takes the initial assessment.
events.details: Krillin has the medical clearance and power reading. A half-hour room slot is available; he asks Zero to set aside cape and scouter and show his stance.

events.title: Taking a stance
events.summary: Zero places the scouter on his removed cape and steps onto the mat, left arm and leg forward.
events.details: Krillin cues fist closure when striking and begins a guarded advance-and-retreat drill.

events.title: Finding the footwork
events.summary: Steady advance and retreat are manageable; abrupt reversals reveal hesitation and a long recovery step.
events.details: Smaller steps improve the slower repeat. Controlled sparring follows the footwork assessment.

events.title: Controlled sparring
events.summary: Krillin avoids or redirects the opening attacks, taps an exposed rib and trips Zero with a controlled palm strike.
events.details: Zero gets back into stance. Krillin advises tracking the body; Vegeta points out the shoulder wind-up. The exercise continues into the afternoon.

events.title: The first spark
events.summary: An afternoon of controlled sparring brings bruises and a minor split lip. Ki practice finally produces three tiny flashes.
events.details: Training moves to the courtyard after the room booking ends. Gathering remains unreliable and fatigue-sensitive. Satan arranges refreshments and reports the room is ready.

events.title: Room 214
events.summary: Zero retrieves cape and scouter, follows Satan to his room and receives the access card before visiting the dining hall.
events.details: Housing and meals are covered. The bedside terminal handles reception and schedules; the escort restriction remains. Krillin recommends rest instead of exhausted overnight practice.

events.title: One week later · 60
events.summary: A week of training, meals and rest yields basic deliberate ki control, low hovering and slow courtyard flight. Rested self-checks now read 60.
events.details: The old split lip heals; ordinary soreness and minor bruises remain. Vegeta gains temporary permission for lower-risk solo work until Zero is field-ready. The latest flight ends upright after a wide turn and stumbling landing. Krillin warns that airborne control still needs too much attention under threat. Satan gives Vegeta the assessment: still not cleared. Vegeta asks what is available tomorrow; no answer is recorded.

events.title: Seeking harder training
events.summary: Zero approaches Krillin after the flight assessment.
events.details: Krillin asks what is bothering him; no new mission is assigned.

events.title: A harder programme
events.summary: Zero asks to train harder and longer. Krillin agrees to increase the work.
events.details: Morning weighted conditioning and longer controlled sparring are arranged, beginning with low aerial pressure practice.

events.title: A new sparring partner · 64
events.summary: Two days of intensified practice bring two rested readings of 64. Krillin introduces Yamcha.
events.details: Krillin reports Yamcha’s full power as 210. Low-flight recovery through light contact improves, but solid body shots still break concentration.

events.title: The opening kick
events.summary: A ki-assisted rush carries Zero around Yamcha’s side, but the spinning kick is blocked.
events.details: Poor braking widens the pivot. Yamcha checks a counter into the ribs; Zero stays upright.

events.title: A feint and a sweep
events.summary: A palm-light feint draws Yamcha’s attention; the sweep catches an ankle and off-balances him.
events.details: Yamcha vaults clear, then advances with a shoulder shove. No actual ki blast was fired.

events.title: Using his momentum
events.summary: Zero catches the reaching wrist and completes a shoulder throw using Yamcha’s forward step.
events.details: Yamcha rolls through the landing without apparent injury, stands and approaches more cautiously with a jab.

events.title: Holding the guard
events.summary: Zero blocks the jab and a short controlled combination.
events.details: The impacts sting and move his guard, but he remains upright. Yamcha circles just outside range.

events.title: The final combination
events.summary: A long attack sequence forces Yamcha to give ground and glances his shoulder.
events.details: Fatigue spoils the final spinning kick. Yamcha interrupts with a controlled chest-palm shove; Zero falls, exhausted, and Krillin ends the round.

events.title: Back on his feet
events.summary: Zero struggles upright, loudly gasping for air.
events.details: Krillin keeps the round stopped and asks whether he is dizzy or just breathless. No serious injury is established.

events.title: Guard raised again
events.summary: Zero raises his guard despite exhaustion.
events.details: Yamcha declines another exchange. Krillin steps between them and keeps the round stopped.

events.title: A break in the spar
events.summary: Zero objects to being coddled. Krillin confirms the break.
events.details: Yamcha sits at the edge of the court. Zero remains standing in guard; no new round occurs.

events.title: Back to the weights
events.summary: Zero equips borrowed wrist and ankle weights and begins shadowboxing without resting.
events.details: Fatigue slows his punches and disrupts footwork. Krillin declines further sparring in that condition.

events.title: Five days of escalating weight
events.summary: The load rises from 5 to 80 kg per limb over five training days.
events.details: Slow technique and ki-light control improve at lighter loads; the final 320 kg total badly slows combinations. A Day 13 check reads 67. By Day 15 evening the exhausted reading is 58.

events.title: One more set
events.summary: Zero reports 58 to Krillin and tries another set.
events.details: Three short punches go out before the right arm stalls below guard. Krillin offers to remove the weights. No new injury occurs.

events.title: Rest and a reading · 68
events.summary: Krillin removes and returns the weights, then escorts Zero to room 214.
events.details: After a couple of hours’ sleep, Zero drinks cola and checks himself: 68. Acute exhaustion has eased, but soreness and tiredness remain.

events.title: Adapting to 320 kg
events.summary: Seven days at 80 kg per wrist and ankle improve short combinations, footing and deliberate ki control.
events.details: Two pre-training scans on Day 22 read 75. At the evening session’s end, Krillin requests an unweighted movement test.

events.title: The first ki blast
events.summary: Unweighted movement is freer, though fast aerial turns remain unstable. One small ki shot reaches the wall.
events.details: The yellow-white shot chips the surface a few metres away. Other attempts fail; reliable repetition has not yet been achieved.

events.title: Four hundred kilos · 84
events.summary: Another week at 100 kg per limb improves short combinations and low-kick recovery.
events.details: Small planted ki blasts become repeatable, with variable aim and poor moving release. Two Day 29 morning scans read 84. Zero remains off field duty.

events.title: Bulma’s maintenance bay
events.summary: Zero returns the weights and finds Vegeta with Bulma, accompanied by Krillin.
events.details: Bulma is repairing equipment and says the training room is out of service. Her home history and relationship with this Vegeta are unknown.

events.title: An agreement at dawn
events.summary: Zero challenges Vegeta to train him. Vegeta grabs and releases his clothing, then agrees.
events.details: Krillin and Bulma intervene. Zero is uninjured. Vegeta specifies dawn outside the training hall, without weights.

events.title: Other versions of the prince
events.summary: Zero invokes Vegeta’s father, Frieza and admiration for another version of him.
events.details: Vegeta rejects the assumed understanding and comparisons, maintains the dawn appointment and leaves. No alternate biography is confirmed.

events.title: Returning to room 214
events.summary: Zero explains his provocation. Bulma agrees Vegeta should train him but objects to the father reference.
events.details: Krillin escorts Zero back to his room and suggests sleep. Bulma’s history and relationship remain unconfirmed.

events.title: Training with Vegeta · 85
events.summary: After overnight rest, Zero arrives two hours early, warms up lightly and scans himself twice: 85.
events.details: Vegeta arrives at dawn, tells him to remove the scouter and invites him to attack. The device is still worn and the first move is pending.

events.title: First rush at Vegeta
events.summary: Zero’s flurry is avoided or deflected. Vegeta catches his wrist and shoves him back, leaving temporary soreness but no serious injury.
events.details: Vegeta opens an adjoining hall. Zero is still outside with the scouter on; no gravity setting has been activated.

events.title: Fifty times gravity
events.summary: Zero follows Vegeta inside, lays the cape and scouter aside and takes a stance. The hall switches to 50× gravity, driving him down.
events.details: Vegeta lifts him, punches his abdomen and drops him. Zero remains conscious and breathing, in severe pain. No healing or power reading occurs.

events.title: Trying to rise
events.summary: Zero struggles toward hands and knees but cannot stand under 50× gravity. Vegeta kicks him in the ribs and knocks him down.
events.details: His cheek bleeds and breathing is painful and shallow. He remains conscious. No diagnosis, senzu or power gain is established by this exchange.

events.title: The first day ends
events.summary: The brutal session continues with two senzu recoveries. Zero manages a partial crouch and two dragging steps at 50× gravity.
events.details: Gravity is lowered during the session to prevent death, then restored. Vegeta ends the day and switches it off. After final healing, two self-scans read 89. Cape and scouter are collected; training resumes tomorrow. No hit lands on Vegeta.

events.title: Two weeks under pressure
events.summary: Daily 25× warm-ups and 50× sessions improve Zero’s loaded movement. Large meals and sleep fill the time between training.
events.details: Restored readings reach 124 on Day 37 and 168 twice at the end of Day 44. Twenty-four senzu are consumed over the fortnight. Zero can now stand, take measured steps and use short combinations at 50×, but quick movement and impacts still disrupt his support. No field clearance or successful strike on Vegeta.

events.title: A rested check
events.summary: After a large dinner and a night in room 214, Zero puts on the scouter and checks himself twice: 168.
events.details: The reading confirms the capacity already measured after Day 44 healing. Sleep has not created another separate power gain; departure for training follows.

events.title: Back to Krillin
events.summary: Another day of 25× preparation and 50× training ends with two senzu recoveries. Fully healed, Zero measures 174 twice and goes to find Krillin.
events.details: Scouter worn, cape collected and clothes bloodstained, Zero reaches an ordinary practice hall as Krillin finishes teaching. Krillin asks whether he received a senzu, then welcomes him in: “I’m finished here. What’s up?” Zero has not answered.

events.title: A year in a day
events.summary: Zero asks Krillin who handles a full-day Hyperbolic Time Chamber booking.
events.details: Krillin explains the year-long interior duration, supplies and suitable programme, then asks whether Zero intends to go alone.

events.title: Going alone
events.summary: Zero confirms that he plans to train alone.
events.details: Krillin offers recorded drills and a flight check, then invites him to speak with Mr. Satan.

events.title: At dispatch
events.summary: Zero follows Krillin to Mr. Satan’s dispatch office.
events.details: Mr. Satan offers Chamber Three for the following morning; confirmation is pending.

events.title: Chamber Three reserved
events.summary: Zero accepts the booking.
events.details: The session runs from Day 46 at 09:00 to Day 47 at 09:00, with one year inside. Krillin will meet him at 08:00 to prepare. Supplies are arranged and Vegeta is notified; no reply is shown.

events.title: Ready at the threshold
events.summary: After dinner and sleep, Zero meets Krillin and completes the chamber preparation.
events.details: His morning reading remains 174. Flight work and recorded drills are reviewed; a year of provisions, six senzu, four drones and maintenance supplies are checked. Krillin explains the controls and appropriate starting loads. Zero is ready to enter.

events.title: Behind the closed door
events.summary: Zero thanks Krillin, enters and closes the door.
events.details: Alone, he lets the fear and exhaustion surface. Memories of Nappa and the pressure of training have weighed on him. He crouches in the living area before beginning any exercise.

events.title: Time to breathe
events.summary: Zero spends the first 48 hours sleeping, eating and slowing down.
events.details: Privacy and extended time relieve some pressure. Fatigue eases; the nightmares have not yet entirely stopped. No training gain is awarded, and the rested reading remains 174. These days are part of the booked year.

events.title: A steady foundation
events.summary: Conditioning, martial drills and basic blast practice fill the first three months.
events.details: Rested readings progress through 269 and 361 to 454. Ground drills reach 25× gravity and slow conditioning 60×. Footwork and ordinary shots improve; solitude suits him. All six senzu remain.

events.title: Under fire
events.summary: Zero enables drone weapons, increases intensity and experiments with suppression.
events.details: Rested readings reach 588, 741 and 920. Ground drills reach 40× gravity and conditioning 100×. Lowering output works best while still and is harder during movement. Three senzu treat training injuries; three remain. Age: 27 years.

events.title: Taking the fight into the air
events.summary: Zero practises aerial combat, compact punches, rotating kicks and faster, larger blasts.
events.details: Drone weapons stay enabled at two lower difficulty levels to preserve senzu. Rested readings reach 1,117, 1,339 and 1,597. Aerial rounds reach 10× gravity, with tighter short volleys and improved flight control. No beans used this quarter.

events.title: One year complete
events.summary: The final quarter brings together movement, strikes, blasts and sustained suppression.
events.details: Rested readings climb through 2,002 and 2,484 to 3,075. Full-output rounds reach 75× gravity on the ground and 25× in the air; slow conditioning reaches 150×. The last three senzu are used. A final test holds near 1,538 through walking and a combination, then returns to 3,075. Four drones are docked as checkout sounds.

events.title: A clean start
events.summary: Zero leaves the chamber, meets Krillin and has his original outfit and cape repaired.
events.details: His build is visibly more muscular. The nightmares have stopped; remembering Nappa brings anger rather than panic. He no longer needs the torn cape as a reminder. Equipment services mends the damage and adjusts the fit without changing the style. At the doorway, Krillin asks, “Better. Ready?” No answer, destination or field clearance has followed.

events.title: Finding Vegeta
events.summary: Krillin accompanies Zero to the sparring court; Vegeta demands an assessment.
events.details: Only his rigid armour is on the bench; he is wearing the blue suit, gloves and boots.

events.title: Full power for assessment
events.summary: Cape and scouter set aside, Zero releases suppression and takes his stance.
events.details: Vegeta opens with a restrained feint and low sweep.

events.title: Headbutt
events.summary: Zero’s headbutt lands without moving or injuring Vegeta.
events.details: Vegeta floors him with a controlled counter; Zero is winded and sore.

events.title: Blast feint and knee kick
events.summary: Vegeta smothers the blast, checks the kick and catches Zero’s ankle.
events.details: His short counter begins while the ankle remains held.

events.title: Point-blank volley
events.summary: Flight avoids the punch, but the volley fails to harm Vegeta.
events.details: Vegeta throws Zero aside; Krillin intercepts a stray shot.

events.title: Field assessment accepted
events.summary: Zero’s flurry lands harmless hits; Vegeta ends the spar and agrees to take him on a mission.
events.details: The accepted ending grants supervised participation against lesser opposition. No lecture about controlling anger or wounded pride occurred.

events.title: First assignment briefing
events.summary: Mr. Satan briefs an illicit equipment-supply operation in TL-218.
events.details: Identify the supplier, stop deliveries and preserve communications equipment. Vegeta recognises Frieza-pattern gear.

events.title: Communicator offered
events.summary: Mr. Satan confirms the supervised return is permitted and offers a collar communicator.
events.details: Arrival is planned at a concealed western ridge.

events.title: Return to TL-218
events.summary: Zero takes the communicator and follows Vegeta through the portal.
events.details: Earth, 16 February Age 763. Four alien Frieza Force soldiers read 640, 780, 920 and 1,100. Zero keeps his scouter; no handover occurs.

events.title: Out-of-place soldiers
events.summary: Vegeta confirms the troops are out of place, while noting their armour does not prove Frieza’s orders.
events.details: Both remain concealed on the ridge.

events.title: Drawing out the commander
events.summary: Vegeta approves Zero approaching the soldiers to provoke a response.
events.details: Preserve the ship and communications equipment; Vegeta claims any worthy challenger.

events.title: Entering the yard
events.summary: Zero lands by the truck with output suppressed near 1,538 and greets the soldiers.
events.details: A blaster is raised and another soldier is told to fetch help.

events.title: A controlled power burst
events.summary: A blast, kick and punch put three soldiers down.
events.details: Zero rises to full power for the strikes then returns to half. The fourth retreats into the ship to raise the alarm.

events.title: Nappa named
events.summary: The injured red-skinned soldier identifies Nappa as his commander.
events.details: Zero allows the other soldier to run; Nappa’s presence is not yet visually confirmed.

events.title: Warehouse search
events.summary: Zero throws the captive aside and enters the warehouse.
events.details: Weapons, armour and an active unfamiliar console are visible; footsteps descend the ship ramp.

events.title: Nappa returns
events.summary: Nappa appears at the loading entrance; the scouter reads 6,000.
events.details: He demands Zero come outside.

events.title: Warehouse destroyed
events.summary: Zero’s outward ki release demolishes the warehouse; the surprise rush bloodies Nappa’s lip.
events.details: The console is buried and disabled. Nappa counters hard; evidence preservation is compromised.

events.title: Contact blasts
events.summary: One palm blast injures Nappa’s ear; he forces the other skyward.
events.details: Zero is grounded with abdominal pain and a strained wrist and shoulder.

events.title: Turles intercepts
events.summary: Nappa’s conditioned tail resists Zero’s grip. Vegeta moves to intervene but Turles intercepts him.
events.details: Nappa elbows Zero’s ribs and continues closing.

events.title: Trading blows
events.summary: Several counters land, but Nappa matches Zero’s movement and wears him down.
events.details: Gravity training gives no extra speed advantage beyond Zero’s actual abilities.

events.title: One more rush
events.summary: Zero forces Nappa back briefly before another counter leaves him coughing blood.
events.details: Nappa begins a close-range blast.

events.title: The eye strike
events.summary: Zero cuts around the blast and concentrates ki into his fingertips, badly injuring Nappa’s right eye.
events.details: No stable blade forms. The shot burns Zero’s shoulder; he is thrown aside, severely depleted.

events.title: Caught by the throat
events.summary: Zero rises and taunts Nappa, who lifts him by the throat.
events.details: His injuries and exhaustion are severe; Nappa draws back his free fist.

events.title: Uncontrolled Dark Factor awakening
events.summary: At the brink, a voice that feels like Zero’s own thoughts coaxes a request for strength.
events.details: Power erupts, throwing Nappa back. A black-and-violet mantle forms; Zero feels dreamlike apparent control. Campaign output: ×15, 46,125; not a scouter reading.

events.title: Nappa’s fruit
events.summary: Zero overwhelms Nappa in the air. Nappa consumes a fruit and becomes much stronger.
events.details: Zero retains the advantage; Nappa’s chest armour shatters.

events.title: A demonic laugh
events.summary: Zero drags Nappa across open ground, drives him upward and slams him back down.
events.details: Nappa lies motionless below; Zero remains aloft, laughing in layers of growling voices.

events.title: Loss of control
events.summary: Zero wants to help Vegeta, but his body accelerates toward a distant city. Vegeta intercepts and knocks him unconscious.
events.details: He wakes in Conton’s ward. The supply site is dismantled, Turles and Nappa escaped, and no city attack occurred. Chronoa asks what he remembers.

events.title: Reporting the takeover
events.summary: Zero describes dreamlike recall and being unable to stop his body.
events.details: Chronoa examines residual energy and asks how it began.

events.title: Dark Factor identified
events.summary: Zero explains the familiar voice and apparent control. Chronoa identifies Dark Factor.
events.details: She proposes containment while investigating whether safe removal is possible.

events.title: The seal
events.summary: Chronoa seals the attachment while Zero is awake, leaving a black circle with four inward hooks below the sternum.
events.details: She explains that losing consciousness or nearing death while channeling can release the uncontrolled state. Closed-channel sleep is safe. Injuries still require healing.

events.title: Recovery and the first test
events.summary: A ward Senzu heals Zero’s injuries and fatigue. He joins Krillin and Chronoa in a normal-gravity training hall.
events.details: Cape and scouter are on the bench. Chronoa makes the seal’s access point perceptible, then withdraws her hand. Zero’s first actual channel attempt remains pending.

events.title: A first controlled draw
events.summary: Zero draws a small flow through the seal while keeping control of his body.
events.details: A faint violet-edged aura appears. Chronoa confirms the seal is holding; Krillin asks Zero to turn the flow off before trying more.

events.title: Closing the channel
events.summary: Zero stops the borrowed flow without disturbing his own ki.
events.details: The aura fades and the seal remains intact. Chronoa authorises a gradual stronger draw; no sparring begins.

events.title: Full Dark Factor Sealed Channel
events.summary: Zero reaches full Dark Factor Sealed Channel with a pale violet aura and red irises.
events.details: The onset sends shockwaves and gusts across the undamaged hall. Roughly thirty seconds into full output, strain rises quickly. Zero remains conscious and in control; Krillin asks him to reduce the flow. The form is still active. Corrected peak: ×10, 37,200; no scan.

events.title: Closing the full channel
events.summary: Zero lets the borrowed power fade while keeping his own ki steady.
events.details: The full channel closes voluntarily. Fatigue remains, but nothing resists the release.

events.title: Learning to move with it
events.summary: A day of supervised practice develops movement with the sealed channel.
events.details: Lower flow becomes easier to sustain through movement; stronger bursts remain tiring. The day’s training brings the base assessment to 3,729, without a new scan or additional outbreak adjustment.

events.title: Dinner with Krillin
events.summary: Zero collects his cape and scouter and joins Krillin for dinner.
events.details: The training day is finished. Both forms are inactive.

events.title: Peace and quiet
events.summary: Zero explains that he enjoyed the chamber’s solitude.
events.details: Krillin confirms that his home timeline had a Room of Spirit and Time, used by Goku, Gohan, Vegeta and Trunks before Cell.

events.title: A chamber left unused
events.summary: Krillin says he never trained in the Lookout chamber himself.
events.details: Their conversation remains over dinner; no chamber booking is made.

events.title: Family in Conton
events.summary: Krillin mentions Eighteen and Marron living with him in the city.
events.details: He offers an informal visit. Zero has not met them, and no appointment is set.

events.title: A night’s rest
events.summary: Zero returns to Room 214 and sleeps before the next morning’s training.
events.details: He leaves the family visit for another time. Breakfast and a seal review precede further practice; neither a visit nor another chamber stay is booked.

events.title: A week of channel practice
events.summary: Seven training days improve control and bring a rested reading of 3,856.
events.details: The scouter was checked and confirmed functional. Chronoa’s early review found the mark unchanged. Full output reached two strenuous minutes in controlled moving sparring, followed by voluntary closure. Lower flow is steadier; the hoped-for permanent absorption has not appeared. Two morning scans confirm 3,856. No senzu or new technique was used.

events.title: Other techniques
events.summary: Zero pauses before sparring to ask Krillin about different kinds of training.
events.details: The conversation begins with both forms inactive; no new instruction is completed.

events.title: Duplication and energy transfer
events.summary: Zero asks about Spirit Control, Tri-Form and transferring ki.
events.details: Krillin offers his version of duplication, warning that the bodies divide the user’s power. It is not a claim to Yardrat mastery, and no duplicate is made. He asks whether Zero means giving energy or taking it.

events.title: Considering absorption
events.summary: Zero is interested in taking an opponent’s energy.
events.details: Moro and Super 17 are discussed as examples; cooperative local versions of Moro or Gero are speculation, not confirmed residents. The corrected reference is Ultra Instinct Goku and Blue Evolution Vegeta in the Moro fight. No absorption method is learned.

events.title: Ways to grow
events.summary: Zero weighs more chamber training, new techniques and potential unlocking.
events.details: Guru’s help to Krillin and Gohan is raised as an example, not an arranged reward. Krillin offers inquiries and a discussion with Hercule; neither has happened.

events.title: On his own merits
events.summary: Zero declines the offered advocacy and spends the day training with Krillin.
events.details: Moving releases become smoother, without a new timed endurance record or named technique. The training assessment reaches 3,874. Krillin leaves for home; no inquiry or meeting is delegated.

events.title: The evening reading
events.summary: After a shower and cooldown, Zero reads 3,874 twice on his scouter.
events.details: In Room 214, both forms are inactive and the seal is closed. His cape lies on the desk; the scouter is worn. Residual muscle soreness remains. No extra gain occurs during the return, shower or checks; dinner and sleep are still ahead.

events.title: Cleanup duty · 4,058
events.summary: A week of supervised Saibaman cleanup and training reunites Zero with Yamcha.
events.details: Variable-gravity transitions, airborne bracing and committed base sparring complement the field work. Zero measures 4,058 twice; Yamcha’s first scan is 2,250. Full channel reaches three strenuous moving minutes, then closes voluntarily. One brief field channel burst; no Senzu.

events.title: Infantry cleanup · 4,249
events.summary: Another week adds coordinated Frieza Force infantry to the cleanup work.
events.details: Screened opponents range roughly 500–2,000. Supervising teams take custody of survivors. Zero measures 4,249 twice and Yamcha 2,360. Three-minute channel drills end with less leg trembling but still cause breathlessness. Vegeta continues solo work; no new scan of him.

events.title: An offer from Yamcha
events.summary: Yamcha offers to teach Wolf Fang Fist.
events.details: Zero feels another chamber stay needs new knowledge first. No technique is learned.

events.title: Learning at the source
events.summary: Zero prefers Yardratian Spirit Control to Wolf Fang Fist.
events.details: He wants instruction on Yardrat itself; no teacher, route or permission is arranged.

events.title: A longer stay
events.summary: Zero would spend a few months on Yardrat.
events.details: Yamcha is interested in joining, subject to arrangements; this is not a booking.

events.title: Yamcha’s Earth
events.summary: Yamcha describes his life in a world without Goku.
events.details: Bulma and Puar drew him out of desert banditry; he later knew Roshi and Krillin and led Earth’s defenders. Raditz came to conquer, killed his fellow fighters, and Yamcha was extracted alive. He was 28.

events.title: Nearly three months away
events.summary: Yamcha arrived in Conton in December and has not returned home.
events.details: Kaioken is discussed as a possible training path. Neither fighter has learned it, and combining it with the sealed channel remains untested.

events.title: The unread record
events.summary: Yamcha has avoided examining his timeline’s recorded future.
events.details: A King Kai inquiry through Krillin is suggested, not delegated or completed. Zero offers company in facing the home-history question.

events.title: A different plan
events.summary: Zero proposes approaching their dispatchers for a homecoming and revival mission.
events.details: Yamcha would face Raditz himself. Approval and the actual Dragon Ball work are still ahead.

events.title: Other Dragon Balls
events.summary: Zero explains that Earth is not the only possible source of wishes.
events.details: Returning just after Yamcha’s extraction is proposed so they can act immediately. No offworld travel is approved.

events.title: Possible routes
events.summary: Namek and Cereal are raised as alternatives.
events.details: Krillin might know Namek, but no escort is arranged. Yamcha has never met Kami; ship access and navigation remain unconfirmed.

events.title: Kami and the Namekians
events.summary: Zero explains Kami’s origin and the split from Demon King Piccolo.
events.details: A possible ancient ship is discussed without assuming this timeline has a usable one. Yamcha goes to his dispatcher.

events.title: Speaking to Hercule
events.summary: Zero presents the homecoming, revival and Yardrat proposal to Hercule.
events.details: Dispatch coordination and readiness checks begin. No wish, new teacher or unrestricted permission follows.

events.title: The recorded course
events.summary: Hercule reviews Yamcha’s history before their intervention.
events.details: Kami and the Earth Dragon Balls are alive and functional. The then-visible course leads from Raditz’s conquest to occupation and resistance through Age 765, with no Prime-style one-year Saiyan invasion or Namek hunt. Yamcha was an original participant in the Raditz fixed point. Dated Age 761 assessments: Raditz 1,500, Nappa 4,000, Vegeta 18,000 and first-form Frieza 530,000. These are this history’s counterparts.

events.title: Clearance to return
events.summary: The dispatchers approve a bounded joint visit for Raditz and the revival effort.
events.details: In the old projected course, occupation pressure and secrecy prevented Bulma and Puar safely collecting the balls; no earlier successful revival is established. Both travellers must return before the revised future can be reviewed and Yardrat plans considered.

events.title: Back at the departure point
events.summary: Zero chooses the 22:00 departure and joins Yamcha on Earth immediately after his extraction.
events.details: Equipment and readiness checks complete. A new active tunnel opens; this timeline’s future is now in flux. Local time is daylight, not Conton night.

events.title: Yamcha faces Raditz
events.summary: Zero stays back while Yamcha takes his fight.
events.details: Zero watches Raditz’s scouter and the intact moon/tail risk. Neither fighter transforms.
events.date: Age 761 · Daylight / 10 March, Age 854 · Conton clock

events.title: Raditz defeated
events.summary: Zero destroys Raditz’s scouter with a precise shot; Yamcha finishes the fight.
events.details: Raditz dies without successfully calling for help. Yamcha has minor injuries but remains mobile; Zero is uninjured. The shot does not replace Yamcha’s victory. No Great Ape transformation occurs.

events.title: Bulma and Puar
events.summary: The fallen fighters are secured nearby, and Yamcha reunites with Bulma and Puar.
events.details: Hercule reports 55% integrity after the major fixed-point rewrite; no forced branch. Yamcha’s native participation permits the change, but the cost is substantial. Collection and revivals would leave 50% at best and remain pending. Bulma produces a working Dragon Radar and asks who Zero is and why he wears a scouter. No answer yet.

events.title: An introduction
events.summary: Zero introduces himself and explains the scouter’s local power-reading function. Bulma’s radar locates the seven balls.

events.title: Yamcha takes the lead
events.summary: Yamcha carries Bulma while Puar flies alongside; Zero accompanies the collection party.

events.title: Seven Dragon Balls
events.summary: Four hours of searching complete the Earth set. The group returns to the sheltered bodies; no wish yet.

events.title: Four friends restored
events.summary: Shenron revives Krillin, Roshi, Tien and Chiaotzu with the single wish for Raditz’s victims. Bulma and Puar were already alive; Yamcha was extracted alive. The balls disperse into their normal cooldown. Integrity reads 50%.

events.title: Meeting the defenders
events.summary: Zero greets all four revived fighters and gives Yamcha the credit for defeating Raditz.

events.title: Yamcha explains
events.summary: Yamcha tells his friends about Conton and his time away. Zero lets him answer their questions.

events.title: A warning about strength
events.summary: Zero explains that he came from elsewhere and warns that Earth’s defenders need much greater strength. He does not disclose the Dark Factor or his fictional-world knowledge.

events.title: Local teachers, distant worlds
events.summary: Zero rejects mass recruitment and repeated foreign instructors as costly interventions. He recommends local offworld travel, with Namek and Yardrat as leads.

events.title: A route to Namek
events.summary: Zero explains Guru’s potential unlocking, Yardrat Spirit Control and Kami’s spacecraft as a navigation and engineering lead. No potential is unlocked here.

events.title: Home again, a changed future
events.summary: Both Patrollers withdraw at 02:44 with 48% integrity. Once outside, they review the new course: Kami’s ship is recovered; Bulma, Krillin, Tien and Chiaotzu reach Namek later in Age 761 and train on Yardrat in Ages 762–763. Earth avoids occupation.

events.title: The rest of the record
events.summary: Outside the timeline, Hercule reviewed its revised course: Earth avoids the Raditz occupation and the native fighters travel to Namek and Yardrat. Gero remains a later threat. Subsequent causal corrections withdraw the original certainty of an easy Android victory, permanent civilian losses and Buu’s permanent absence for lack of power.
events.details: The original report is preserved in the exact local archive. This summary incorporates its controlling corrections; missing later authoring is not in-universe flux.

events.title: Time to recover
events.summary: Zero recommends letting TL-503 restore before another visit. Gero remains a future concern, not a cleared mission.

events.title: Treatment and breakfast
events.summary: Yamcha has his Raditz injuries treated, then both eat. Zero gains no power or items from the stop.

events.title: Rest before another teacher
events.summary: Zero agrees to accompany Yamcha to Krillin, then returns to his room to sleep.

events.title: Finding Krillin
events.summary: Zero dresses and meets Yamcha. They seek Krillin’s help finding a King Kai who can teach them.

events.title: King Kai’s garden
events.summary: Krillin introduces an alive resident King Kai at his Conton home. Zero wants power he can use independently; combining Kaioken with the sealed channel is only a question at this point.

events.title: Showing the seal
events.summary: Zero explains the attached Dark Factor and shows the abdominal seal. No identity or future wish outcome is revealed.

events.title: First afternoon of instruction
events.summary: Three productive hours begin the Kaioken fundamentals. Zero’s base measures 4,257 twice; Yamcha’s assessed base becomes 2,383. Neither has activated Kaioken yet.

events.title: The first red flare
events.summary: Two weeks of instruction bring Zero to 4,542 and Yamcha to an assessed 2,503. Yamcha first activates Kaioken ×2 on 23 March; Zero follows on 24 March. Initial bursts last only one or two seconds.

events.title: Holding the technique
events.summary: Another fortnight brings Zero to 4,841 and Yamcha to 2,623. Kaioken ×2 reaches twenty seconds for Zero and fifteen for Yamcha in controlled practice. Sensing exercises do not erase Zero’s established suppression skill.

events.title: A combination that fails
events.summary: Six weeks of training conclude at Zero 5,119 and Yamcha 2,735, with moving Kaioken ×2 demonstrations of 45 and 35 seconds. A small cooperative Spirit Bomb is released in practice. The 15 April channel/Kaioken test triggered a takeover: Kaioken collapsed and Uncontrolled Dark Factor replaced the channel. Krillin contained it, Chronoa checked the intact seal, and 16 April was recovery. No stable stacked form or extra vessel gain resulted.

events.title: Checking possible routes
events.summary: Zero visits Hercule. A separate Cereal assignment is discussed, not accepted; it is not an approved training visit.

events.title: TL-503 recovering
events.summary: The fresh reading is 86%, up from the withdrawal reading of 48%. Restoration has no guaranteed daily rate; no new interference is reported.

events.title: Training before Gero
events.summary: Zero prioritises Yardrat study after the timeline finishes recovering. Hercule begins the itinerary and dispatcher review; no departure occurs.

events.title: Nappa on Namek
events.summary: An alert shows Nappa recruiting on TL-619 Namek. Zero insists on going; Hercule dispatches reinforcement behind him. This near-Prime history places Z and later events one year later, making the local year Age 763.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:52 Conton

events.title: Three readings
events.summary: Zero’s scouter reads Nappa at 7,200, Jeice at 40,000 and Burter at 43,000. He steps out from cover.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:52 Conton

events.title: The stronger fruit
events.summary: Zero opens the channel at a calculated 51,190. Nappa consumes a ×10 fruit and reads 72,000. Jeice and Burter watch rather than joining him.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:53 Conton

events.title: Compact counters
events.summary: Zero pivots past Nappa and throws four rapid kicks; two land and two meet his guard. Technique creates an opening without erasing the power gap.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:53 Conton

events.title: Wide arcs
events.summary: Zero sends twenty ordinary blasts on preset curves and attacks through the debris. Three catch Nappa from behind; this is not a homing technique.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:53 Conton

events.title: An invitation
events.summary: Zero steadies his stance and beckons Nappa forward, keeping the channel active.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:53 Conton

events.title: Into the water
events.summary: A knee interception and headbutt send Nappa downward. Both remain in the fight.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: A small gathering
events.summary: Zero gathers a modest amount of cooperative spirit energy while watching Nappa. It is not a full battlefield Spirit Bomb.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: Spirit Spear
events.summary: Zero names an improvised contact release of gathered spirit energy. The first discharge scorches Nappa’s armour; it does not pierce his body or permanently increase Zero’s base.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: Pressure at close range
events.summary: Zero presses with kicks and punches; Nappa catches a leg and counters. The fight remains contested.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: An elbow against the punch
events.summary: Zero brings his elbow into the incoming strike, accepting the painful collision to disrupt Nappa’s attack.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: A double knee drop
events.summary: Zero turns them in flight and drives Nappa toward the water with both knees planted against his chest.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: Underwater exchange
events.summary: Zero pushes away and drives both feet into Nappa under the surface. Breath and movement are becoming constraints for both.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: Denied the surface
events.summary: Zero catches Nappa’s foot and hauls him downward; Nappa counters and breaks toward air.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: Air and a taunt
events.summary: Both surface. Zero questions the fruit’s duration, but no definite expiry or universal time limit is established.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: Inside the blast
events.summary: Zero rushes Nappa before he can finish firing and resumes close exchanges, landing body pressure without a clean finish.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: A second charge
events.summary: Zero tries to open space for another small spirit-energy gathering as Nappa pursues.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: A tighter Spirit Spear
events.summary: Zero gets above and behind Nappa and releases the gathered energy into his back. It breaches a small section of already-damaged armour and burns underneath; it is not a through-body beam.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: The answering blast
events.summary: Nappa fires upward as Zero challenges him. The channel and accumulating fatigue remain important limits.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: From beneath the water
events.summary: Zero dives below the attack, then rises into an uppercut with the speed and force he can still muster.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:54 Conton

events.title: No breathing room
events.summary: Zero follows with a feint, a kick to the damaged ribs and sustained blows before Nappa can recover.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:55 Conton

events.title: Nappa goes down
events.summary: The final knee and barrage leave Nappa unconscious but alive at 18:55:16. Zero retains control after roughly two minutes forty-one seconds in the channel; this is not a new endurance maximum.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:55 Conton

events.title: Turles intervenes
events.summary: Turles ambushes Zero, dragging him through the ground and throwing him offshore. Zero closes the channel before consciousness fails. Vegeta and Yamcha arrive; the integrity report is 84%. Current campaign assessments are Vegeta 4 million and Turles 1.8 million, not scouter readings by Zero.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:55 Conton

events.title: A rescue bean
events.summary: Yamcha brings Zero to an offshore island and offers a Senzu. Zero’s scouter is broken; the attackers remain engaged nearby.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:55 Conton

events.title: Extraction requested
events.summary: Zero eats the Senzu, his 36th, and asks for immediate extraction. Turles’s ×10 fruit brings him to an assessed 18 million against Vegeta’s 40 million Wrathful. Local scouters can report them to Frieza; remaining would endanger the timeline.
events.date: Age 763 · Namek daylight / 22 April, Age 854 · 18:56 Conton

events.title: Everyone through
events.summary: Zero and Yamcha cross, then Vegeta withdraws. The portal closes at 18:56:52 with all three safely back in Conton.

events.title: Alive when left
events.summary: Zero confirms Nappa was unconscious, not killed, when Turles attacked. The broken scouter is removed.

events.title: An answer for Vegeta
events.summary: Zero meets Vegeta’s challenge without backing down. No new power or injury is awarded for the exchange.

events.title: Seventy-two thousand
events.summary: Zero reports Nappa’s fruit reading and explains that he won through cleaner fighting rather than greater raw power. Vegeta orders him to the courtyard the next morning.

events.title: The completed record
events.summary: The debrief shows 68% integrity and no forced branch. Turles carried Nappa out at 18:57:20; Jeice and Burter did not join. Their report prompted Frieza’s search, but the Ginyu/Goku, Frieza/Goku, evacuation and destruction sequence stayed intact. Nappa’s later recovery is unknown.

events.title: The same red scouter
events.summary: Equipment services repairs the original scouter and confirms Zero’s base at 5,190 twice. This is ordinary combat development; the Senzu and injuries grant no separate boost. Its old network remains disconnected.

events.title: Ready for the courtyard
events.summary: Zero has his clothes repaired, eats and sleeps, then prepares for Vegeta. The Yardrat briefing is ready, but no trip has been approved or taken.

events.title: Another assessment
events.summary: Zero leaves cape and scouter aside and opens the channel at a calculated 51,900 opposite Vegeta.

events.title: Tight movements
events.summary: Zero slips outside the punch, intercepts the forearm and attacks behind the knee. Vegeta remains overwhelmingly stronger and controls the spar.

events.title: Above the sweep
events.summary: Zero lifts clear and tries a close knee. The restrained exchange tests recovery and positioning, not equality with Vegeta.

events.title: Training and commendations
events.summary: Eight productive hours with Vegeta bring Zero’s base to 5,213, measured twice. That evening Zero, Vegeta and Yamcha receive commendations. Zero redeems his for the Four-Star Ball of set TP-RS-647; no other balls or wish are granted.

events.title: Making the power his own
events.summary: Zero explains the intended integration wish. Chronoa considers bodily integration viable and offers help with wording; no wish is performed or outcome guaranteed.

events.title: Two other rewards
events.summary: Vegeta chooses a dedicated gravity-training room with persistent settings and guest control. Yamcha chooses better accommodation. Handovers are arranged for the next morning.

events.title: A safe place for the ball
events.summary: Zero stores the Four-Star Ball wrapped in clean cloth in his bedside cabinet’s bottom drawer, sleeps, then receives Yamcha’s breakfast invitation. Mild shoulder stiffness remains, with no significant injury.

events.title: Namek before Yardrat
events.summary: Over breakfast, Zero proposes joining Yamcha’s friends on Namek, asking Guru for help and training there before a separate Yardrat trip. No potential unlock, defence agreement or departure is secured.

events.title: Accommodation and an itinerary
events.summary: Yamcha selects the courtyard-facing apartment and receives access. Hercule confirms Vegeta’s room handover and a fresh TL-503 reading of 87%. He supports reviewing Namek first, then a return for recovery and a revised Yardrat itinerary. Departure remains pending. He asks Zero whether he wants weeks or months on Namek; the answer has not happened.

events.title: Four weeks of service
events.summary: Four weeks of training and eight cleanup assignments brought Zero to 5,791 measured; Yamcha 3,038 and Vegeta 4.2 million assessed. Zero received the Two-Star Ball, Yamcha an unspent commendation. TL-503 restored to 100%.

events.title: Namek clearance
events.summary: Up to four weeks on Namek approved, with a two-week check-in. Earth stop needs separate review.

events.title: Packing and a briefing
events.summary: Both Dragon Balls stored in Room 214. Chronoa prepared a seal briefing for Guru.

events.title: Arrival on Namek
events.summary: Zero accepted the scroll and departed with Yamcha, reuniting with Bulma, Krillin, Tien and Chiaotzu near Kami’s ship. The future is in flux.
events.date: 22 May, Age 854 · 14:05 Conton / Age 761 · Namek daylight

events.title: A village welcome
events.summary: Luggage stored aboard the ship. The village elder heard about Kami and the revived defenders and invited them inside.
events.date: 22 May, Age 854 · 14:25 Conton / Age 761 · Namek daylight

events.title: An audience with Guru
events.summary: The elder escorted the fighters to Guru; Bulma stayed at the ship. Guru examined Yamcha’s memories with consent and asked to examine Zero.
events.date: 22 May, Age 854 · 15:30 Conton / Age 761 · Namek daylight

events.title: The seal briefing
events.summary: Guru read Chronoa’s briefing, examined Zero with consent and requested a private conversation. The binding remained closed.
events.date: 22 May, Age 854 · 15:40 Conton / Age 761 · Namek daylight

events.title: A confidence kept
events.summary: Guru promised to keep Zero’s origin private and offered to release his own potential.
events.date: 22 May, Age 854 · 15:42 Conton / Age 761 · Namek daylight

events.title: Potential released
events.summary: Guru released Zero’s own dormant capacity with the seal closed and intact. His ordinary white aura surged and subsided; the additional strength remained.
events.date: 22 May, Age 854 · 15:45 Conton / Age 761 · Namek daylight

events.title: A new reading · 69,497
events.summary: Zero thanked Guru and measured his base at 69,497: the accepted twelvefold release from his exact pre-unlock base. The others returned, sensing the increase without knowing the number. Yamcha asks for the reading; Guru invites him forward, but his release remains pending.
events.date: 22 May, Age 854 · 15:47 Conton / Age 761 · Namek daylight

events.title: Yamcha’s potential released
events.date: Age 761 · Daylight · Namek, TL-503 · Grand Elder’s home
events.summary: Zero tells Yamcha the 69,497 reading and steps aside. Guru releases Yamcha’s own potential.

events.title: Yamcha’s scouter reading
events.date: Age 761 · Daylight · Namek, TL-503 · Grand Elder’s home
events.summary: Zero scans Yamcha at 26,431 after the release; no Kaioken is active.

events.title: The native fighters’ potential released
events.date: Age 761 · Daylight · Namek, TL-503 · Grand Elder’s home
events.summary: Guru releases Krillin, Tien and Chiaotzu’s potential. Their readings are not scanned; Nail offers training.

events.title: First practice on Namek
events.date: Age 761 · Daylight · Namek, TL-503 · Training ground below the western ridge
events.summary: Zero accepts Chronoa’s protected scroll back and follows Nail and the others outside to begin control practice.

events.title: Two weeks training on Namek
events.date: Age 761 · Daylight · Namek, TL-503 · Expedition landing site
events.summary: Two weeks with Nail develop control and sensing. Zero measures 73,176; integrity is 94%. The remaining two weeks are offered.

events.title: Finishing the Namek training visit
events.date: 19 June, Age 854 · 16:20 Conton / Age 761 · Namek daylight
events.summary: The full four-week stay concludes. Zero measures 77,000; integrity is 92%. Bags are packed for return.

events.title: Plans before departure
events.date: Age 761 · Daylight · Namek, TL-503 · Expedition landing site
events.summary: Zero outlines more training, service and Dragon Ball collecting before a later Yardrat visit; the wish itself is not disclosed to the group.

events.title: Return from Namek
events.date: 19 June, Age 854 · 16:24 · Conton City · Dispatch return point
events.summary: Zero requests extraction. He and Yamcha return to Conton with their luggage and the protected scroll.

events.title: Namek training debrief
events.date: 19 June, Age 854 · 16:30 · Conton City · Dispatch return point
events.summary: The pair report Guru’s releases and Nail’s training. Hercule offers to look for more challenging work.

events.title: Arms interception briefing
events.summary: Hercule offers an arms interception on Earth, TL-846, Age 750. Scout readings are 95,000 and 31,000; the Red Ribbon buyers have not arrived.

events.title: Deployment to the quarry
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Western quarry ridge
events.summary: Assignment accepted. Bags are secured at dispatch; Zero and Yamcha deploy behind the quarry’s western ridge.

events.title: Surrender offered
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Quarry floor
events.summary: The dealers identify one another as Brask and Rivet, mock the Patrol and threaten the pair. Rivet aims his rifle; Brask blocks the cargo. No negotiated departure offer occurs.

events.title: Opening strike
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Above the quarry terraces
events.summary: Zero strikes Brask’s stomach and carries him away from the cargo, releasing base suppression. Yamcha engages Rivet.

events.title: Kaioken combination
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Above the quarry
events.summary: A brief Kaioken ×2 combination batters Brask and throws him into empty quarry ground. Zero releases Kaioken as Brask begins transforming.

events.title: Golden and violet
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Above the quarry
events.summary: Brask’s completed transformation reads 950,000. Zero opens Sealed Channel at a calculated 770,000; Brask attacks behind a close flash.

events.title: Counter through the flash
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Above the quarry
events.summary: Zero uses nearby ki to orient through the flash, checks the knee and lands a partial body shot. Brask blocks the descending kick and counters.

events.title: Reversal
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Above the quarry
events.summary: A flight-assisted reverse spin evades the grab and punch, landing beneath Brask’s chin.

events.title: Keeping pressure
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Above the quarry
events.summary: Zero pressures Brask with body strikes. Brask shoulder-checks his chest and attempts a clinch and elbow.

events.title: Breaking the clinch
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Above the quarry
events.summary: Zero ducks the elbow, lands a knee and escapes the pin. His elbow clips Brask’s jaw; Brask pulls away and fires two blasts.

events.title: Driving him down
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Above the quarry
events.summary: Zero evades, closes with a feint and rib kick, then fires violet blasts and punches Brask into the quarry floor. Brask remains conscious but badly hurt.

events.title: Across the quarry
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Quarry floor
events.summary: Yamcha uses a brief Kaioken burst to disarm and knock down Rivet. Brask edges toward the shuttle while Zero guards his route.

events.title: Brought down
events.date: Age 750 · Late afternoon · Earth, TL-846 · Quarry floor
events.summary: Zero intercepts Brask and slams him into the ground. Brask loses consciousness and reverts; Rivet surrenders.

events.title: Extraction
events.date: 19 June, Age 854 · 16:56 · Conton City, Patrol medical ward
events.summary: Zero closes the channel and calls for extraction and medical support. Prisoners are secured; the pair return for treatment of bruises and strain. No Senzu is used.

events.title: Transformation report
events.date: 19 June, Age 854 · 16:58 · Conton City, Patrol medical ward
events.summary: Zero reports Brask’s 950,000 reading, white hair and gold aura. Medical staff clear the pair to rest; no biological explanation is established.

events.title: Back for dinner
events.date: 19 June, Age 854 · 17:55 · Conton City, dining hall
events.summary: Bags are retrieved, Zero showers and changes into the same outfit design, then eats. Hercule confirms cargo and shuttle recovery; the mission nexus closes.

events.title: Post-Brask reading and sleep
events.summary: Two evening scans read 77,616, 616 above the pre-fight benchmark. Zero sleeps; bruises improve, with the wrist still sore.

events.title: Freight booking evidence
events.date: 20 June, Age 854 · 07:25 · Conton City, Hercule's dispatch office
events.summary: At breakfast-time debrief, Hercule explains the ordinary shuttle used an external passage booking and customer transponder. The unused lunar return window has expired.

events.title: Prisoners refuse cooperation
events.date: 20 June, Age 854 · 07:27 · Conton City, Hercule's dispatch office
events.summary: Both prisoners refuse useful answers and remain smug under questioning. Hercule offers an interview; Zero has not accepted.

events.title: Returning to the teachers
events.date: 20 June, Age 854 · 16:20 · Conton City, Vegeta's training room
events.summary: Zero leaves questioning to others, trains with Yamcha under King Kai and spars with Vegeta. A cooled-down scan reads 77,780. No higher Kaioken is unlocked.

events.title: Dinner and rest
events.summary: Dinner, shower and sleep follow. Zero wakes at six for the arranged seven o’clock Vegeta session, with mild residual soreness.

events.title: A week of separate projects
events.summary: A week of Vegeta mornings, King Kai afternoons and partner practice includes two cleanup assignments. Zero reaches 79,682; modest moving Spirit Spear charges and sensing improve. Yamcha begins Alpha research, without unlocking it.

events.title: Breakfast with Yamcha
events.date: 28 June, Age 854 · 06:20 · Conton City, dining hall
events.summary: Zero dresses and meets Yamcha for breakfast. Yamcha intends to ask Krillin about an Alpha-capable counterpart.

events.title: Plans after breakfast
events.date: 28 June, Age 854 · 06:40 · Conton City, outside the dining hall
events.summary: Zero plans Vegeta training first and a timeline check afterwards. Yamcha goes to find Krillin and agrees to meet later.

events.title: Morning rounds and a recovered timeline
events.date: 28 June, Age 854 · 11:30 · Conton City, Hercule's office
events.summary: Morning training ends with a measured 79,807. At Hercule’s office, a fresh TL-503 check reads 100%; the native Yardrat expedition remains. Duration awaits confirmation, with no departure booked.
